reportTitle: Phase 7A.3 Managed Storage & DSH Home Resolution Verification Evidence

homeResolution.explanation: DSH home is resolved strictly through official Cordis context surfaces provided by the DSH host runtime (profileContext or dshHomePath) or explicit parameter injection. The active runtime bundle contains 0 process.env occurrences, preserving the Store credentials=false invariant without requiring @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths as a runtime dependency.

versionedDatabaseArtifacts.windowsHandleSafety: Databases use immutable versioned filenames rather than static mutable files. Hot-swapping switches databaseFile references in active.json rather than replacing locked SQLite files on disk, ensuring safety under Windows open file locking.

atomicMetadataPersistence.writePattern: serialize -> write sibling active.json.tmp-<uuid> -> flush -> atomic rename over active.json
atomicMetadataPersistence.databaseReferenceStyle: relative basename only, strictly matching ecdict-<identity>.sqlite3 and preventing path traversal or host leakage
atomicMetadataPersistence.malformedJsonHandling: fail-closed, throws without modifying active.json or disk
atomicMetadataPersistence.invalidSchemaHandling: fail-closed, throws without modifying active.json or disk
